widgets_values:
## photos/multi-view

Alternate views of ONE subject for image-to-3D. Load a clean photo of a single
character or object and Queue prints it four times: front, right side, back, and
top-down, all four holding the same face, costume, material, and silhouette.

One `EZSnapImage` squares the source to the Klein grid, one `VAEEncode` turns it into
the latent canvas, and four `ReferenceLatent` nodes pin all four samplers to that one
plate. Seed 42 is fixed and shared, Klein 4B distilled runs 4 steps at CFG 1.0, and the
four SHOT cards differ only in where the camera stands. Type the subject once in
IDENTITY; the shot cards are graph chrome and stay put.

Prints `ez_multiview_front`, `ez_multiview_side`, `ez_multiview_back`, and
`ez_multiview_topdown`.

This is a subject turntable, not a room tour. `photos/identity-sheet` and
`photos/dream-house` walk a camera through a place and its furniture; here the world is
a bare cyclorama and the thing that must not change is one character or object. Do not
describe rooms, walls, or furniture in IDENTITY.

Models: flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors + qwen_3_4b.safetensors (CLIP type flux2) + flux2-vae.safetensors. Apache-2.0.

Chain: LoadImage -> EZSnapImage -> VAEEncode -> ReferenceLatent -> KSampler ->
VAEDecode -> SaveImage, four times over the one shared plate. Do not Queue without a
start image. Handoff: `3d/multi-image-asset` and `3d/hero-from-photos`.

Occupancy: klein - stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
nodes.title: Operator note

widgets_values: A photoreal studio still of one original character: a deep-space salvage diver in a scuffed matte-charcoal EVA suit, one mustard-yellow harness strap, a chipped crimson helmet stripe, and one unmarked brass-core pendant. Height, build, face, hairstyle, suit panels, stitching, hardware, scuffing, and every color are fixed. The subject alone stands centered on a seamless neutral grey cyclorama, full body with clear space above the helmet, under one soft key light and one fill. Nothing else is in frame: no second figure, no set dressing, no props beyond the pendant, no lettering.

inputs.label: Detail
inputs.description: draft is a quick look. standard is what this App ships tuned for. final is the best this App's own stack can do. A rung never changes size and never leaves this App's model stack. The caption names the steps, CFG, weights, and license Queue actually sends.

inputs.label: Rewrite negative
inputs.description: On: rewrite this negative so it cannot fight the final positive. Stays on when Rewrite prompt is off. Off skips the LLM; a conflict filter still runs.
